text:
CONNECTOR::profile
Description
This command gets the connector profile name in the current context.
Syntax
CONNECTOR
::
profile
Examples
when
CONNECTOR_OPEN
{
if
{([
CONNECTOR
::
profile
]
eq
"/Common/connector_profile_1"
)}
{
log
local0.
"CONNECTOR_OPEN raised by connector_profile_1"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
Introduced: BIGIP-16.1.0
